consequence.statement: Environments configured with querier.worker-parallelism via CLI flag or YAML will have this setting ignored in Loki 3.0.0; the configuration key no longer exists to control worker parallelism.
consequence.remediation: Replace querier.worker-parallelism configuration with querier.max-concurrent to control the maximum concurrent requests processed by queriers.

evidence.locator: L596-L597 (3.0.0 › Loki 3.0.0 › Deprecated configuration options are removed)
evidence.excerpt:
1. `querier.worker-parallelism` CLI flag and its corresponding yaml setting are now removed as it does not offer additional value to already existing `querier.max-concurrent`.
    We recommend configuring `querier.max-concurrent` to limit the max concurrent requests processed by the queriers.
